audit.whatIsWrong: The chart hands Cassiopeia levels 3 onward while the packet records a 100% win rate, and the packet itself flags the contradiction.
audit.why: The win rate rests on 4 games, which is noise, and the full and content layers already agree with each other row for row. The mirror recorded the same conflict as champion-wide and did not resolve it, so flipping rows here would create a mirror disagreement on the strength of four games.
audit.corrected: No side or rating edits; the prose was corrected in place and the conflict is raised as a question.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike calls Petrifying Gaze a point-blank stun and no stage carries a cooldown.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 825 range on 120/100/80s and stuns only enemies facing her — anyone with their back turned is slowed instead. Noxious Blast (Q) is 850 range on a flat 3.5s, Miasma (W) is 24s at rank 1, and Twin Fang (E) fires every 0.75s at 700 range.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rebuilt on the 825 range and the facing rule; whys[3] and wants.foe[2] given real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr claims your Q out-ranges hers, the cooldown line sells Miasma's grounding as the threat, wants.you[2] says her E poisons, and Twin Fang's healing is never mentioned.
audit.why: Noxious Blast and Bouncing Bomb are both 850 — there is no range edge. The gap that decides the lane is Twin Fang at 700 against your 850: outside it she has only the poison tick. Miasma grounds movement abilities, and Ziggs has no dash, so the grounding costs you almost nothing while the slow does the damage. The poison comes from Noxious Blast and Miasma; Twin Fang is the payoff that consumes it and heals her for a percentage of the damage, which is why Grievous Wounds decides long trades.
audit.corrected: tldr rebuilt on the 850-vs-700 gap; dosFull[0].d restated on the slow rather than the grounding; wants.you[2] corrected; spikes[0].text now carries the healing and the anti-heal buy; focus.text moved from Miasma to Twin Fang.
